name: Whitehurst Custom Woodworking
old_description: Whitehurst Custom Woodworking specializes in handcrafted, heirloom quality furniture. Timeless designs, focus on function and an emphasis on natural materials and proper joinery techniques are used to craft each piece. Love your space with irresistible furniture that works for your lifestyle.
about:
Whitehurst Custom Woodworking operates from Raleigh, North Carolina. The business was founded by Jeremy, who grew up in Tarboro, NC, watching his father work with metal. After purchasing his first home in college, he began building small pieces and eventually turned his woodworking passion into a full-time career after more than a decade and two other careers.

The shop produces handcrafted, heirloom-quality furniture with an emphasis on timeless design, function, natural materials, and traditional joinery techniques. Its core offerings include custom furniture pieces and end-grain butcher blocks. The company serves the Raleigh, Durham, and Chapel Hill areas, though it ships beyond the region.

Customers are primarily residential clients seeking custom furniture for their homes. Testimonials reference a cherry wood dining table, a sewing station, and other personalized pieces, illustrating a focus on one-off commissions rather than volume production.

Jeremy states his mission is to preserve the craft of fine furniture making by offering the community furniture built with exceptional craftsmanship rooted in tradition while embracing innovation. The company's tagline, “How it’s made matters,” underscores its commitment to process and material integrity.

name: Wicker Brothers Inc
old_description: At Wicker Brothers Custom Fabrication, we pride ourselves on being a fully equipped fabrication shop, ready to handle a wide range of projects, big or small. From design and prototyping to final installation, our team is committed to delivering high-quality results every step of the way.
about:
Wicker Brothers Inc operates a custom metal fabrication shop in Florence, Mississippi. The company serves clients across the region with a full range of fabrication services from design through installation.

The shop provides design and prototyping, welding (TIG, MIG, and laser), field repairs and installation, and both small- and large-scale manufacturing. Its equipment includes multiple press brakes (up to 200-ton), hydraulic shears, ironworkers, horizontal bandsaws, plate rolls, a pipe bender, angle and tube rolls, a spot welder, belt sanders, a Timesaver wide belt sander, CNC cutting (Amada 3 kW fiber laser, Messer high-definition plasma, Calypso waterjet), three lathes, three mills, a 10' x 10' x 25' powder coating oven, and industrial sandblasting pots. The company also deploys 15 fully equipped service trucks for on-site work.

Wicker Brothers serves hospitals, restaurants, and shipping companies, among other industries. Its medical and hospital clients rely on the shop for custom metal components and installations, while restaurant and shipping customers use its fabrication and repair capabilities.

The company emphasizes in-house control of every production stage to maintain delivery schedules and quality. A certified drafting and design team works with clients from concept to completion, and the breadth of CNC cutting and finishing equipment allows the shop to handle diverse projects without outsourcing.

name: Wilderness Trace Solar
old_description: Located in Danville, KY. Wilderness Trace Solar specializes in solar panel installation and solar panel maintenance. 5-Year workmanship warranty. Free estimates. Transparency and trustworthiness. Call today and request a quote.
about:
Wilderness Trace Solar was founded in 2015 in Danville, Kentucky, and serves residential, commercial, agricultural, and municipal customers across Central and Eastern Kentucky. The company is locally owned and operates from a facility that includes a warehouse stocked with solar panels, inverters, racking, and mounting hardware for both installed systems and do-it-yourself purchases.

The business provides turn-key solar energy solutions, handling system design, permitting, installation, and ongoing maintenance. Its technicians carry OSHA 10 and NABCEP certifications, and the company is a member of the Kentucky Solar Energy Industries Association (KYSEIA). In addition to installation services, Wilderness Trace Solar sells equipment from brands such as Emmvee, SolarEdge, SMA Solar Technology, APsystems, SnapNrack, Powers Solar Frames, and SIGMATEK. The team emphasizes a 5-year workmanship warranty and passes through manufacturer warranties on all components.

Customers include homeowners seeking to reduce electricity bills, farms and agri-businesses aiming to lower operational costs, and commercial or industrial facilities looking to cut energy expenses while meeting sustainability goals. The company also works with municipal projects and assists clients with federal investment tax credits (ITC) and the generation and sale of solar renewable energy certificates (SRECs).

Wilderness Trace Solar differentiates itself through a transparent, relationship-focused approach that includes free estimates, a single point of contact for the entire project, and guidance on available tax incentives. The firm’s combined staff experience exceeds 20 years, and it promotes its certifications and association membership as markers of professional accountability.

name: Wilson Auto Parts
old_description: For over four decades, Wilson Auto Parts has stood as a pillar of reliability in the wholesale automotive parts industry of northern New Jersey. Our dedication is to streamline your work, not add to it.
about:
Wilson Auto Parts has served the wholesale automotive parts market in northern New Jersey for over four decades. Headquartered in Plainfield, the company operates a network of eleven locations across the region, including Dover, Neptune City, Newark, Kearny, West Orange, Paterson, Roselle Park, Jersey City, Clifton, and Hackensack.

The distributor supplies a broad range of automotive parts and supplies to service stations, independent repair shops, and commercial garages. Its multi-branch model allows customers to source all needed components through a single call, with inventory drawn from across the network and billing consolidated into one invoice. The company leverages long-standing relationships with manufacturers to offer a comprehensive and cost-effective product range.

Primary customers include automotive service stations, repair shops, and fleet maintenance garages throughout northern New Jersey.

Wilson Auto Parts was founded to streamline procurement for automotive service businesses, eliminating the hassle of multiple vendors and deliveries. The company states its mission is to deliver the right parts at the right time and price, backed by a team of industry-experienced account managers and customer service experts.

name: Winar Connection
old_description: Winar has been in the wire and cable industry since 1982. Since then we have focused on developing and perfecting our processes for large cable, wire harness & leads, and so much more!
about:
Winar Connection was founded in 1982 in Richfield, Ohio, as a family-run business focused on wire and cable solutions. The company later expanded to a second facility in Spartanburg, South Carolina, while maintaining its headquarters in Richfield. Ownership remains American-made and American-owned, with the founding family still guiding operations after more than four decades.

The company manufactures custom cable assemblies, wire harnesses, and wire leads, offering precision cutting, stripping, crimping, custom labeling, and value-added assembly services. Its production floor includes a Schleuniger Crimp Center 64 purchased in 2013, multiple fully automatic crimping machines, a braiding machine, and an ultrasonic welder. Winar also operates vendor-managed inventory (VMI) and stocking programs for customers. The workforce averages 20 years of tenure, representing over 100 years of combined applied knowledge.

Winar serves industries including motive power, battery charging, electrical power grid, load banks, and data centers. Its customers range from purchasing agents and engineers seeking custom cable solutions to vendor partners who access Winar’s broad customer base across those sectors.

The company emphasizes its American-made, American-owned identity, supported by certifications such as UL, IPC, ISO 9001:2015, and WHMA. Its stated values—integrity, caring, inspiration, excellence, and continuous improvement—underpin a “WIN” philosophy built on wisdom, improvement, and nimbleness.

name: Wire Machine Systems
old_description: Wire Machine Systems (WMS) was founded in 1987 in Fort Wayne, IN. Since its start, WMS has become a premier source of equipment and services to the wire, cable, bar, and tube industries, offering a “one-stop shop” solution to meet all of your needs. Wire Machine Systems’ facility is centrally located to operate on a national and international level as a trusted supplier of machinery, equipment, and spare parts.
about:
Wire Machine Systems was founded in 1987 in Fort Wayne, Indiana. The company began as a supplier of equipment and services to the wire, cable, bar, and tube industries, positioning itself as a one-stop shop for machinery and spare parts.

The company provides state-of-the-art manufacturing equipment for wire and cable drawing, insulation, handling, and surface treatment, as well as drawbenches, peeling and straightening systems, measuring instruments, buncher bows, spring coiling machines, and shot blasting systems for bars and tubes. It also maintains a centralized spare parts warehouse in Fort Wayne stocking replacement components for European and Asian machinery, and offers dedicated technical support to help customers source the exact part or machine they need.

Wire Machine Systems serves manufacturers in the wire, cable, bar, and tube sectors, including automotive, appliance, and industrial spring producers that require high-precision coiling and tight-tolerance processing. Its customer base spans national and international operations across these industries.

The company emphasizes its one-stop-shop model, combining equipment sales, spare parts availability, and technical support under one roof. It highlights over 50 years of combined industry experience, a centralized warehouse for rapid delivery, and the ability to supply replacement parts for equipment it did not originally sell, aiming to minimize downtime for its clients.
